title: Water Heater Rebates in Ottawa 2026: $500 With an Assessment
desc: Ottawa heat pump water heater rebate for 2026: $500 under Home Renovation Savings, paired with a second upgrade, with cold-climate and Better Homes Ottawa details.
lead: Ottawa's water heater rebate is $500 and needs an assessment plus a second upgrade. With January lows of -13.2°C, the installation location matters as much as the rebate.
cards_heading: What Home Renovation Savings pays for a heat pump water heater in Ottawa
cards_intro: We re-read the program's page and its eligibility requirements on October 3, 2026. There is no stand-alone water heater rebate in Ontario's program. The $500 comes with an assessment and at least one other upgrade.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: Paid for replacing a gas, oil, propane or electric water heater with an ENERGY STAR certified heat pump water heater on NRCan's list, installed by a licensed professional.

cards.title: Not a stand-alone rebate
cards.note: The $500 is only paid inside the assessment stream, which requires at least two qualified measures. A water heater counts as one.

cards.title: Home energy assessment
cards.note: $600 comes back when the program is completed. The first and follow-up assessments cost money up front, and $600 comes back when the program is completed.

cards.title: Three or more upgrades
cards.note: A third qualified upgrade, such as insulation, windows or air sealing, earns another $500.

cards.title: Program cap
cards.note: $10,000 for homes heated by electricity, oil, propane or wood and $5,000 for Enbridge gas homes, across all measures.

cards.title: Better Homes Ottawa loan
cards.amount: Loan repaid on your tax bill
cards.note: Repaid on the property tax bill over 20 years. Excludes gas upgrades. Up to the lesser of $125,000 or 10% of assessed value, over 20 years.

after_cards: The post-audit must be scheduled by November 30, 2026 and completed by December 31, 2026, or within 180 days of your first assessment, whichever comes first.
sections: A heat pump water heater draws heat from the air around it, so a cold utility room changes how it performs. Ottawa's January average low is -13.2°C, and a basement in an older house can be cool. The program does not set a location rule, so ask the installer where the unit will go and how it will be vented or ducted.

Of Ottawa's 407,250 households, 44% live in homes built before 1981 and 64,225 are owner-occupied detached houses of that age. For those, attic insulation is a natural partner. The attic can pay up to $1,500 in the assessment stream, and together with the $500 water heater it clears the two-measure minimum.

For gas homes, the old tank has to be a natural gas water heater. For oil, propane, wood or electrically heated homes, the old tank can be oil, propane or electric. Check which category your home and tank fall into before the installer quotes.

The City's loan is repaid on the property tax bill and excludes gas upgrades. We recorded up to the lesser of $125,000 or 10% of assessed value over 20 years, with 0% for households under income thresholds. Confirm current terms with the City.
When the house has tenants or a suite

The program requires you to own the home, and where an owner has tenants the owner must apply. In Ottawa, 36% of households rent. A house built as a single dwelling that later gained a secondary suite is eligible if the audit covers the whole home and a central heating system serves it. A house built as a multi-family dwelling is not eligible.

Sequence the steps: first assessment, then installation, then follow-up. The post-audit has to be scheduled by November 30, 2026 and completed by December 31, 2026, or within 180 days of the first assessment, whichever comes first. A water heater can be installed in a day, but the follow-up visit depends on the advisor's calendar, so book both early.
claim_steps: Confirm your home is an eligible type and find out what fuel heats it.
Book the first home energy assessment with a registered energy advisor before any work starts.
Choose at least one more upgrade to pair with the water heater, such as insulation, windows or air sealing.
Choose an ENERGY STAR certified heat pump water heater from NRCan's list and have a licensed, trained professional install it.
Keep invoices and your property tax bill, and book the follow-up assessment before the December 31, 2026 deadline.
